Commodities vs. Construction
How to tell the difference at MSU
COMMODITIES
Commodities generally include
goods and services purchased
by the institution.
CONSTRUCTION
Construction generally includes
work that builds, alters, renovates,
or improves a facility or
physical space.
Supplies
Equipment
Contractual services
Office or lab materials
Standard purchased goods
New buildings
Renovations
Major repairs or alterations
Facility improvements
Build-out projects
Think: items or
services you buy.
Think: work that
changes a building
or space.
KEY DISTINCTION
If the procurement is for goods or services, it is generally a
commodity. If the work changes or improves a facility,
it is generally construction.
